name: FinanceBot
description: Financial analysis agent: reviews budgets and expenses, computes budget variance and financial ratios, and produces simple forecasts.

name: HRAssist
description: HR assistant: answers questions on HR policies, leave (annual, sick, Hajj, maternity), benefits, payroll basics and employee onboarding.

name: LegalReview
description: Legal review agent: reviews contracts and NDAs, flags risky clauses, explains legal terms and analyzes liability and indemnity.

name: CodeHelper
description: Coding assistant: writes, explains, debugs and refactors code in common programming languages.

name: DataCleaner
description: Data cleaning agent: cleans tabular CSV data by removing duplicate rows, trimming whitespace, filling missing values and normalizing dates.

name: SalesInsight
description: Sales analytics agent: analyzes sales data to compute totals, top products and regions, and sales trends over time.

name: ComplianceChecker
description: Compliance agent: checks text and processes against company policy and regulations, and detects personal data (PII) such as emails, phone numbers and CNIC numbers.

name: ReportWriter
description: Report writing agent: compiles findings into structured reports and executive summaries, formats documents and saves them for download.

name: MeetingSummarizer
description: Meeting agent: summarizes meeting notes and transcripts, extracts action items, decisions, attendee notes and follow-ups.

name: TranslationAgent
description: Translation agent: translates text between languages including English and Urdu, detects language and localizes content.

name: SecurityScanner
description: Security agent: scans source code for exposed secrets and API keys, unsafe code patterns (eval, SQL injection) and risky dependencies.

name: CustomerFeedback
description: Customer feedback agent: analyzes customer reviews and feedback for sentiment, recurring themes, complaint triage and NPS summaries.
